notes: React careers app at careers.urbancompany.com/jobs. POST https://www.urbanclap.com/api/v2/platform-gateway/getAllJobs with an empty JSON body returns all 9 rows; the request has no query or filter parameters and the app renders every returned row. The app exposes a client-side keyword search plus department/location options (department_options=['Business'], location_options are the city values); no server-side filters or pagination exist.
